issues.title: [N10] Post-N9 hardening and performance review
issues.body:
<!-- raveldex:N10:start -->
Conclude the post-N9 engineering review from completed matched measurements and bounded, claim-based recovery qualification; preserve adverse evidence without requiring exhaustive research before product work.

**Track:** release. **Progress:** 7/7 tasks accepted.

**Exit criteria**

- Preserved sources, artifacts and frozen historical methods remain identifiable; new scoped qualification has a dated method and is never pooled into an incomplete older collection.
- Exact results, atomic state, native limits, receipts, cancellation and essential failure recovery remain strictly verified for every claimed supported configuration.
- Completed query/update cohorts and recovery outcomes have independent review and explicit limits; the full 204-context/450-minute recovery experiment is optional, not a mandatory milestone exit.
- A finite scoped conclusion states gains, regressions, safe refusals and unknowns without universal capacity, latency, memory, accessibility or publication claims.

**Task checklist**

- [x] [RX-9001](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/94) — Freeze post-N9 artifacts and a validated comparison method
- [x] [RX-9002](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/95) — Audit combined lifecycle and recovery hardening coverage
- [x] [RX-9003](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/96) — Repair confirmed defects and verify the measurement candidate
- [x] [RX-9004](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/97) — Measure matched native build and query performance
- [x] [RX-9005](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/98) — Measure incremental update costs and state preservation
- [x] [RX-9006](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/99) — Qualify supported recovery paths with bounded evidence reuse
- [x] [RX-9007](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/100) — Publish a scoped engineering verdict and remaining limitations

Roadmap: `ROADMAP.md` (local artifact). Task detail: `IMPLEMENTATION_TASKS.md` (local artifact).

Closing this overview alone does not complete its tasks. Completion requires accepted evidence in the canonical roadmap.

**Current tracking closeout — 8 November 2026.** The owner explicitly requested this N10 issue/milestone alignment. Canonical acceptance is the current local `docs/planning/roadmap.json` over HEAD `0d18463b06e1ac90acb40ca503fad92ac4cb996d` plus uncommitted N10/N11 work. Paths below identify local artifacts, not current `main` URLs. Self-contained acceptance summaries make the result reviewable without pretending the source/evidence has been committed or pushed. Existing notes outside managed markers are preserved historical checkpoints. No package publication, release or deployment is claimed.

**Accepted evidence summary**

All seven canonical N10 tasks are accepted. RX-9001–RX-9005 were already closed/completed and remain unchanged. Accepted under the November 7 scoped qualification amendment, using reviewed unchanged recovery evidence with no new runtime case or benchmark. The original collection supplies 48 current-role ordinary successful contexts / 24 exact Node-direct, Chromium-direct and real-module-worker source/positions-offset recipes at 1k/10k, default 30s/explicit 60s. Separate six-record Node and five-record actual Chromium 149/IndexedDB/worker fixtures establish literal membership, hand BM25, original UTF-16, prior-state atomicity, Unknown versus committed receipts, later writes and disposal. All 140 relevant input hashes and 285 non-UI compiled members match. Exact repeated-excerpt adversarial successes do not guarantee arbitrary 10k capacity: current normal real-docs/high-cardinality preflight 181/183/185/187 export WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, with zero-attempt dependent restores. Original146/204 remains Fail/incomplete and separate from the22-context preflight (26 Pass/22 Refused/2 Cancelled/60 Not run operation rows;20 exports refuse; admitted 141/179 are diagnostic). No full recovery speed/p95 or broad platform claim. Both independent audits and resulting-document reviews pass. Current scoped acceptance is recorded in local docs/evaluation/RX-9006-scoped-20261108.md and docs/evidence/RX-9006/scoped-20261108/README.md; older incomplete reports remain historical, unchanged evidence.

Reviewed engineering verdict synthesizes the accepted original query/update cohorts and scoped recovery qualification. Node query-only:228 matched-success wall comparisons faster versus pre-N9; the full Node cohort has272 faster wall comparisons and CPU194 faster/6 slower/72 overlapping. Conservative browser wall decision is40 faster/8 quantum-limited (direct18/6, real worker22/2); raw46/2 remains historical. Update wall cells403 faster/4 slower/53 overlapping; CPU196 faster/17 slower/247 overlapping. Four small N100/core wall regressions and all CPU costs remain explicit. Two exact Node adversarial 10k restore refusal-to-success transitions have no equal-work speed ratio. AcceptedN9 and measured current are identical implementation controls; no extra post-N9 optimization or weighted winner. Original archive/method/host identities, same-runtime variation, sparse/descriptive p95, v2 sampling/reuse, observer effects, recovery refusals/Unknown and optional heap/platform/full-recovery gaps stay distinct. Query/host audit retains 310 Node comparison cells and288 browser metric rows; update audit preserves 57 adverse rows. Two independent resulting-report reviews plus applicable local planner/generated/reference/diff and preservation checks pass. New report and support guidance are nonpackaged; no new benchmark, engine change or publication.

Tracking closeout record: `docs/evidence/RX-9007/tracking-closeout/README.md` (local artifact). This bounded operation updates only RX-9006, RX-9007, this overview and milestone 12. Existing passing evidence is reused. N11 remains complete; no optional benchmark or new implementation slice is selected.
